questions.prompt: What is the official way to scaffold a new Next.js project?
questions.explanation: create-next-app is the official CLI. Running it with npx downloads and runs it without a global install.

questions.prompt: Match each npm script to what it does.

pairs.right: Starts the development server with Fast Refresh
Serves the built output in production mode

questions.explanation: dev is for everyday development, build produces the production output, and start serves that output in production mode.

questions.prompt: On what port does the Next.js dev server run by default? Type just the number.
questions.explanation: next dev serves your app at http://localhost:3000 by default.

questions.prompt: Which statements about a default App Router project are true? Select all that apply.

options.text: The app/ folder holds your routes and components
Files in public/ are served from the site root, like /logo.png
You should commit node_modules to Git

questions.explanation: app/ holds your code, public/ serves static files from the root, and next.config.ts configures Next.js. node_modules is generated and is gitignored by default.

questions.prompt: Put the steps to create and run a new project in order.
questions.explanation: Scaffold, enter the folder, start the dev server, then open the browser and start editing.
